# Changements cassants acceptés par décision explicite (lus par oasdiff --err-ignore dans .github/workflows/ci.yml).
# Une ligne par changement : méthode, chemin et texte du changement tel qu'oasdiff le rapporte. Retirer une ligne dès
# que la base de comparaison la contient (elle ne sert plus).
#
# Lot 0.5 (PR #13) : StoredFile.sha256 nullable tant que le fichier n'est pas analysé (schema.sql, décision validée).
# Aucun consommateur réel : fl.upload n'est basculé qu'au lot 1.1, seul le mock Nitro l'appelait.
POST /api/v1/uploads/{id}/complete response property `sha256` list-of-types was widened by adding types `null` to media type `application/json` of response `202`
POST /api/v1/uploads/{id}/complete the `sha256` response's property pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` was removed for the status `202`

# Lot 1.3 (PR #19) : RequestApproved.handoff nullable (décision Q6 validée : responsable déjà titulaire d'un compte actif,
# rattaché sans code). Aucun consommateur réel : pf.req.approve n'était appelé que par le mock Nitro avant ce lot.
POST /api/v1/platform/association-requests/{id}/approve added `#/components/schemas/Handoff, subschema #2` to the `handoff` response property `anyOf` list for the response status `200`
POST /api/v1/platform/association-requests/{id}/approve the `handoff` response's property `type` changed from `object` to `any` for status `200`
POST /api/v1/platform/association-requests/{id}/approve removed the required property `handoff/activationUrl` from the response with the `200` status
POST /api/v1/platform/association-requests/{id}/approve removed the required property `handoff/code` from the response with the `200` status
POST /api/v1/platform/association-requests/{id}/approve removed the required property `handoff/expiresAt` from the response with the `200` status
POST /api/v1/platform/association-requests/{id}/approve removed the required property `handoff/mailtoUrl` from the response with the `200` status
POST /api/v1/platform/association-requests/{id}/approve removed the required property `handoff/message` from the response with the `200` status
POST /api/v1/platform/association-requests/{id}/approve removed the required property `handoff/recipient` from the response with the `200` status
POST /api/v1/platform/association-requests/{id}/approve removed the required property `handoff/smsUrl` from the response with the `200` status
POST /api/v1/platform/association-requests/{id}/approve removed the required property `handoff/whatsappUrl` from the response with the `200` status
# Lot 1.3 : bornes anti-abus du formulaire public (charge ALTCHA, champ piège). Le seul client, le front, envoie une
# charge ALTCHA de quelques centaines d'octets et laisse le champ piège vide.
POST /api/v1/public/association-requests the `altcha` request property's maxLength was set to `4000`
POST /api/v1/public/association-requests the `website` request property's maxLength was set to `200`
# Lot 1.4 (PR #20) : prix des plans en F CFA (XOF) seulement (décision validée, CHECK plans_currency_xof). L'énumération
# devient une constante. Seul client : l'écran plateforme des plans, qui n'envoie que XOF.
POST /api/v1/platform/plans the `currency` request property const value `XOF` was added
POST /api/v1/platform/plans removed the enum value `GNF` of the request property `priceMonthly/currency`
POST /api/v1/platform/plans removed the enum value `GNF` of the request property `priceYearly/currency`
POST /api/v1/platform/plans removed the enum value `XAF` of the request property `priceMonthly/currency`
POST /api/v1/platform/plans removed the enum value `XAF` of the request property `priceYearly/currency`
POST /api/v1/platform/plans removed the enum value `XOF` of the request property `priceMonthly/currency`
POST /api/v1/platform/plans removed the enum value `XOF` of the request property `priceYearly/currency`
PATCH /api/v1/platform/plans/{id} the `currency` request property const value `XOF` was added
PATCH /api/v1/platform/plans/{id} removed the enum value `GNF` of the request property `priceMonthly/currency`
PATCH /api/v1/platform/plans/{id} removed the enum value `GNF` of the request property `priceYearly/currency`
PATCH /api/v1/platform/plans/{id} removed the enum value `XAF` of the request property `priceMonthly/currency`
PATCH /api/v1/platform/plans/{id} removed the enum value `XAF` of the request property `priceYearly/currency`
PATCH /api/v1/platform/plans/{id} removed the enum value `XOF` of the request property `priceMonthly/currency`
PATCH /api/v1/platform/plans/{id} removed the enum value `XOF` of the request property `priceYearly/currency`

# Lot 2.3 : mb.lookup, associationsCount peut valoir 0 (compte existant sans aucune appartenance, ex. personnel de la
# plateforme ; décision Q10). Aucun consommateur réel : mb.lookup n'est appelé que par le mock Nitro avant l'étape 8.
POST /api/v1/associations/{aid}/members/lookup the `oneOf[subschema #2]/associationsCount` response property's min was decreased from `1.00` to `0.00` for the response status `200`
